title: UI action bindings
description: Every action the game can be asked to do, and the keys it ships bound to (spec 125). Defaults are data rather than code, which is what lets the keybinding window offer reset without a build step. additionalProperties is false throughout.

chord.description: A physical control and its modifiers. `code` is KeyboardEvent.code for a key -- so a binding is to a position on the keyboard and survives a layout change -- or one of the pointer codes (spec 189). The pointer half is an enum rather than a free string because those codes are invented here rather than by the DOM: a typo'd "Mouse5" would be a row that validates, ships, and binds nothing.

anyOf.description: A mouse button or a wheel notch. Must match POINTER_CODES in src/ui/input/actions.ts.
A KeyboardEvent.code. Left open: the DOM owns that vocabulary and it is long.

id.description: Dotted and stable. Stored profiles reference it, so renaming one loses a player's binding.

context.description: Which context the action resolves in. The same key can mean two things in two contexts, which is what lets a rebind row capture Digit1 without also casting.
